properties.description:
tools/check_consumer_reach.py, wired into ci.yml and the AGENTS.md gate block, with tools/test_check_consumer_reach.py as its regression net. A gate for THIS repository's CI, so it lives under tools/ and rightly claims no reach of its own — its first run on the finished export flagged its own record, whose text used the very phrases it matches (the lesson of fact:lesson-a-record-that-quotes-a-phrase-detectors-phrases-trips-the-detector, earned twice in one day), and this description is worded around that.

THE RULE: a realized Capability whose name or description promises to work beyond this repository — the phrase family is the PROHIBITED-CLAIM regex in the script, not repeated here — must be REALIZED by at least one artifact that actually ships: the served binary (a location under crates/) or the kit (getting-started/, plus the tools/ files release.yml copies into the kit tarball). One realized ONLY by scripts under tools/ fails the build, with the claim sentence and the realizers named, so the fix is to serve it or bound the claim — never to delete the capability to go green.

THE SHIPPED SET IS READ OFF THE DELIVERY CONTRACT, NOT A HAND LIST: the gate parses release.yml's `cp tools/<file> kit-stage/` lines. Its first run flagged the machine-wide installer (tools/reflow2_install.py) as unreachable — which release.yml DOES copy into the kit — and that false positive is what put the parse there and corrected the defect record's own sentence about the kit's contents.

OBSERVED FAILING on the unfixed export (the wall check, and only it) before the served tool was linked as a realizer; passes once crates/reflow2-mcp/src/wall_check.rs realizes that capability.

WHAT IT CANNOT SEE: a promise phrased in words the regex does not match, and a capability realized by nothing at all (that is `unrealized_capability`'s gap, not this one). Both are stated in the script's docstring.
properties.name: A capability that promises to work on other people's projects is realized by something that ships — or this repo's build fails
